title: Rank 1: Ippon-Datara with Sukukaja
requirement: Ippon-Datara (Hermit) with Sukukaja
walkthrough: Fuse Sylph (Temperance) with Archangel (Justice). Sylph learns Sukukaja at level 12, so level Sylph up first, then perform the fusion.

title: Rank 2: Matador with Mahama
requirement: Matador (Death) with Mahama
walkthrough: Fuse Anzu (Hierophant) with Berith (Hanged Man). Anzu learns Mahama at level 19, so level Anzu up first, then inherit it during fusion.

title: Rank 3: Gdon with Beast Weaver
requirement: Gdon (Sun) with Beast Weaver
walkthrough: Fuse Ares (Chariot) with Shiisaa (Hierophant). Ares knows Beast Weaver from the start; simply inherit the skill during the fusion.

title: Rank 4: Neko Shogun with Bufula
requirement: Neko Shogun (Star) with Bufula
walkthrough: Special cross-fusion of Ara Mitama + Kusi Mitama + Saki Mitama + Nigi Mitama. First, fuse King Frost (has Bufula) with Hua Po to get Kusi Mitama, inheriting Bufula. Then complete the cross-fusion.

title: Rank 5: Black Frost with Auto-Sukukaja
requirement: Black Frost (Fool) with Auto-Sukukaja
walkthrough: Special pentagram fusion: Jack Frost + Pyro Jack + King Frost + Pixie + Ghoul. First, fuse High Pixie (who learns Auto-Sukukaja at level 23) with Ghoul to get Jack Frost, inheriting Auto-Sukukaja. Then perform the pentagram fusion.

title: Rank 6: Yatagarasu with Megido
requirement: Yatagarasu (Sun) with Megido
walkthrough: Fuse Taotie (who has Megido naturally) with Cu Chulainn to get Yatagarasu. Make sure to inherit Megido.

title: Rank 7: Yatsufusa with Mediarahan
requirement: Yatsufusa (Hanged Man) with Mediarahan
walkthrough: Special pentagram fusion: Thoth + Orthrus + Makami + Mot + Neko Shogun. First, fuse Alraune (who has Mediarahan naturally) with Triglav to get Mot, inheriting Mediarahan. Then complete the fusion.

title: Rank 8: Ganesha with Tetrakarn
requirement: Ganesha (Star) with Tetrakarn
walkthrough: Fuse Decarabia (who learns Tetrakarn at level 50) with Cu Chulainn to get Ganesha. Inherit Tetrakarn.

title: Rank 9: Trumpeter with Mind Charge
requirement: Trumpeter (Judgement) with Mind Charge
walkthrough: Special hexagram fusion: Taowu + White Rider + Red Rider + Black Rider + Pale Rider + Trumpeter. First, level Taowu to level 38 to learn Mind Charge, then complete the fusion, inheriting Mind Charge.

title: Rank 10: Special Treatment / Complete Empress
requirement: Max out Empress Social Link by talking to Margaret after showing Trumpeter
reward: Empress Social Link Rank 10, Spiral Brooch (Unlocks Isis fusion)
walkthrough: Once Trumpeter with Mind Charge is shown to Margaret in the Velvet Room, talk with her again to finalize the Rank 10 bond. In New Game+, defeat all optional dungeon bosses to unlock the ultimate challenge battle against Margaret herself.

title: Quest 1: I Wish to Befriend My Classmate
requirement: Find the girl at the school lobby who wants to talk to a classmate.
walkthrough: Speak to the girl in Yasogami High 1F lobby. Next day, speak to her again and choose 'I don't know her'. The day after, talk to her one more time to complete.

title: Quest 2: I Wish I Had My Snacks
requirement: Feed a hungry child at the Shinto Shrine.
walkthrough: Talk to the boy at the Tatsuhime Shrine. Buy 'Meat Gum' from the beef bowl or candy shop or feed him a Super Duper Meat Gum, then talk to him again.

title: Quest 3: I Wish I Had a Hobby
requirement: Help the man who wants a new hobby.
walkthrough: Talk to the man in Yasoinaba shopping district (North). Give him an 'Unfinished Model' obtained from the hobbyist in town, then construct it in your room and deliver it to him.

title: Quest 4: I Wish I Could Speak English
requirement: Help the student who is failing English.
walkthrough: Meet the student near the flood plains. Obtain 'English Study Book' or answer their questions correctly over 3 days (Answers: 'Group of words', 'Overcoat', 'Explain a reason').

title: Quest 5: I Wish My Dog Would Return
requirement: Find the lost dog.
walkthrough: Look for the dog near Samegawa Flood Plain. Feed it Beef Skewer or Steak daily for 3 consecutive sunny days until it trusts you and returns home.

title: Quest 6: I Wish I Had a Boyfriend
requirement: Help the girl find love.
walkthrough: Talk to the girl at Yasoinaba Shopping District South. High School 1F hallway, talk to the boy, report back to her and choose encouraging options.

title: Quest 7: I Wish I Could Find a Real Job
requirement: Help the unemployed man find work.
walkthrough: Find job flyers in the town bulletin board, recommend a job at the daycare or pub, and check on his progress over 2 days.

title: Quest 8: I Wish for World Peace
requirement: Help the shrine visitors find peace of mind.
walkthrough: Talk to the elderly woman at the shrine, clean up the shrine grounds with her, and pray at the Tatsuhime Shrine.

title: Quest 9: Catch the River Guardian
requirement: Catch the legendary Guardian fish at Samegawa River.
reward: Hermit Social Link Rank 10 (Fox healing discount maxed out)
walkthrough: Obtain Inaba Jewel Beetle from bug catching at night. Fish during rainy weather or thunderstorm at Samegawa River using the Jewel Beetle bait to catch the Guardian. Show it to the Fox.
